title: Wheat
description: One ripe wheat clump for a 1 m field cell: seven golden stalk bundles with pale diamond-shaped ears. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + head), instanced by the thousand.
checks: 3/4 tile: seven separate tufts, each a golden stalk bundle with a paler diamond-shaped ear on top
TOP tile: the clump stays inside the 1 m cell and covers most of it
FRONT tile: the tallest ear reaches the top of the box (0.9 m), the stalks start on the grid line
